senses.gloss:
दृढ or Ved. दृऌह, अस्, आ, अम्, fixed, firm,
hard, strong, solid, massive; firmly fastened, shut
[]
fast; tough; difficult to be bent (as a bow), compact;
tight, close, dense, without interstices, (opposed
to भिन्न); durable; confirmed, established; not
giving way, stubborn; certain, sure, not subject to
vacillations; secure; reliable; steady, persevering;
great, intense, excessive, severe, violent, mighty,
powerful, important; (in mathematics) reduced to
the last term or smallest number by a common
divisor; (अस्), m. a term in music; N. of a son of
the thirteenth Manu; of one of the sons of Dhṛta-
rāṣṭra; (आ), f., N. of a Buddhist goddess, ‘the
goddess of the earth;’ (अम्), n. anything fixed or
firm or solid; a stronghold, fortress; iron; (अम्),
ind. firmly, fast, much, in a high degree, excessively;
thoroughly, very well.
—दृढ-कण्टक, अस्, m.
‘having hard thorns,’ a kind of plant, = क्षुद्र-
फलक, commonly धलाङ्कदा; (आ), f. the wild
date tree, Phœnix Sylvestris.
—दृढ-काण्ड, अस्,
m. ‘having a strong stem,’ a bamboo; (आ), f. a kind
of creeping plant, = पाताल-गरुडी; (अम्), n. a kind
of fragrant grass (= दीर्घ-रोहिषक).
—दृढ-
कारिन्, ई, इणी, इ, ‘acting firmly,’ resolute, persevering,
determined.
—दृढ-क्रोध, अस्, आ, अम्, having
violent anger.
—दृढ-क्षत्र, अस्, m. ‘having
strong prowess,’ N. of one of the 100 sons of
Dhṛta-rāṣṭra.
—दृढ-क्षुरा, f. ‘having hard
blades,’ a kind of grass, = वल्व-जा.
—दृढ-गा-
त्रिका, f. ‘having hard particles,’ granulated sugar.
—दृढ-ग्रन्थि, इस्, m. ‘having hard knots,’ a
bamboo.
—दृढ-ग्राहिन्, ई, इणी, इ, seizing firmly,
i. e. pursuing an object with untiring energy.
—दृ-
ढ-च्छद, अस्, m. ‘having hard leaves,’ a kind
of fragrant grass, = दीर्घ-रोहिषक.
—दृढ-
च्युत or दृऌह-च्युत or दृढाच्युत, अस्, m.,
N. of a son of Agastya or author of a hymn of the
Ṛg-veda; [cf. दार्ढ-च्युत.]
—दृढ-ज्ञान, अम्,
n. certain knowledge, firm conviction.
—दृढ-तर,
अस्, आ, अम्, firmer, harder.
—दृढ-तरु, उस्, m.
‘the strong tree,’ Grislea Tomentosa (= धव).
—दृढ-ता, f. or दृढ-त्व, अम्, n. firmness,
hardness, solidity, strength; steadiness, perseverance.
—दृढ-तृण, अस्, m. ‘the strong grass,’ a kind
of grass, Saccharum Munjia; (आ), f. a kind of grass, =
वल्व-जा.
—दृढ-तोरणार्गल, अस्, आ, अम्, hav-
ing the bars of the gates firmly fastened.
—दृढ-
त्वच्, क्, m. ‘having tough bark,’ a kind of reed, =
यावनालशर.
—दृढ-दंशक, अस्, m. ‘having
strong teeth or a hard biter,’ a shark.
—दृढ-
दस्यु, उस्, m., N. of an old sage, also named
Idhma-vāha, (son of Dṛḍha-cyuta; cf. दृढस्यु.)
—दृढ-द्वार, अस्, आ, अम्, having strong gates,
having the gates well-secured.
—दृढ-धन,
अस्, m. ‘having secure wealth,’ an epithet of Śākya-
muni.
—दृढ-धनुस्, उस्, m. ‘having a strong
bow,’ N. of a prince who was an ancestor of Śākya-
muni; (also read दृढ-हनु, दृढ-हनु, दृढाश्व.)
—दृ-
ढ-धन्वन्, आ, आ, अ, having a strong bow; (आ),
m. a good archer; (perhaps) N. of a man.
—दृढ-
धन्विन्, ई, इनी, इ, having a strong bow, a strong
or sure archer; (perhaps) furnished with strong
archers.
—दृढ-धुर्, ऊर्, ऊर्, ऊर्, having a strong
pole or beam; able to bear a weight or load.
—दृढ-नाभ, अस्, m., N. of a spell or for-
mula for restraining magical weapons.
—दृढ-
निश्चय, अस्, आ, अम्, ‘having a fixed determination,’
certain, confirmed, corroborated, undoubted.
—दृ-
ढ-नीर, अस्, m. ‘having strong juice,’ the cocoa-
nut tree.
—दृढ-नेत्र, अस्, m. ‘strong-eyed,’
N. of one of the sons of Viśvā-mitra.
—दृढ-
नेमि, इस्, m. ‘having a strong circle or wheel (?),’
N. of a prince who was a son of Satya-dhṛti.
—दृ-
ढ-पत्त्र, अस्, m. ‘having strong leaves,’ a bamboo;
(ई), f. a kind of grass, = वल्व-जा.
—दृढ-पाद,
अस्, m. ‘firm on the feet,’ epithet of Brahmā; (आ),
f. a kind of plant, = यव-तिक्ता; (ई), f. Flacourtia
Cataphracta.
—दृढ-प्रतिज्ञ, अस्, आ, अम्, keep-
ing a promise, firm to a promise, faithful to an
agreement.
—दृढ-प्रत्यय, अस्, m. firm confi-
dence.
—दृढ-प्ररोह, अस्, m. ‘growing strongly,’
the holy fig-tree (= प्लक्ष).
—दृढप्रहारि-ता,
f. hard striking &c.
—दृढ-प्रहारिन्, ई, इणी, इ,
[]
striking hard, hitting strongly or firmly, shooting
surely.
—दृढ-फल, अस्, m. ‘having a hard fruit,’
the cocoa-nut.
—दृढ-बद्ध, अस्, आ, अम्, firmly
bound, tied tightly.
—दृढ-बन्धन-बद्ध,
अस्, आ, अम्, caught fast in a snare.
—दृढ-बन्-
धिनी, f. ‘winding closely round a tree or stem,’ a
kind of creeper, Echites Frutescens (= श्यामा).
—दृढ-बल, अस्, m., N. of a medical author.
—दृढ-भक्ति, इस्, इस्, इ, ‘firm in devotion,’ faith-
ful, devoted.
—दृढ-मति, इस्, इस्, इ, firm-minded,
strong-willed, firm, devoted.
—दृढ-मन्यु, उस्,
उस्, उ, violent in anger or grief.
—दृढ-मुष्टि,
इस्, इस्, इ, ‘having a hard fist,’ close-fisted, one whose
hand is difficult to be opened; one who does not
open his hand, miserly, niggardly; (इस्), m. a sword,
any weapon furnished with a hilt or handle; [cf.
गाढ-मुष्टि.]
—दृढमुष्टि-ता, f. firmness or
tightness of grasp.
—दृढ-मूल, अस्, m. ‘having
a hard root,’ the cocoa-nut; a kind of grass, Saccha-
rum Munjia (= मुञ्ज); another kind of grass (=
मन्थानक).
—दृढ-रङ्गा, f. ‘having a fast
colour,’ a sort of white substance, = स्फटी, com-
monly फट्किरी (sulphate of alumine?).
—दृढ-
रथ, अस्, m. ‘having a strong chariot,’ N. of one
of the 100 sons of Dhṛta-rāṣṭra; of a son of
Jayad-ratha and father of Viśva-jit; (with Jainas)
N. of the father of the tenth Arhat of the present
Ava-sarpiṇī.
—दृढरथाश्रय (˚थ-आश्˚), अस्,
m. ‘having a firm chariot-seat,’ N. of one of
the 100 sons of Dhṛta-rāṣṭra.
—दृढ-रुचि,
‘of great glory,’ N. of a Varṣa.
—दृढ-लता, f.
‘having strong branches,’ a kind of plant, = पाताल-
गरुडी.
—दृढ-लोमन्, आ, आ, अ, coarse-haired,
having coarse bristles; (आ), m. a wild hog; coarse
hair, bristles.
—दृढ-वज्र, अस्, m. ‘having a
strong thunderbolt,’ N. of a king of the Asuras.
—दृढ-वर्मन्, आ, m. ‘having strong armour,’
N. of one of the 100 sons of Dhṛta-rāṣṭra.
—दृढ-वल्कल, अस्, m. ‘having a hard bark,’
Artocarpus Locucha (= लकुच); the areca-palm
(= पूग).
—दृढ-वल्का, f. ‘hard-barked,’ a
kind of plant, = अम्ब-ष्ठा.
—दृढ-विक्रम,
अस्, आ, अम्, having great fortitude.
—दृढ-वीज,
अस्, m. ‘having hard seeds,’ Cassia Tora (= चक्र-
मर्द); Zizyphus Jujuba, = वर्वूर, a kind of
plant.
—दृढ-वृक्ष, अस्, m. ‘the firm tree,’
the cocoa-nut.
—दृढ-वेधन, अम्, n. piercing
strongly, striking firmly.
—दृढ-वैरिन्, ई, m. a
relentless foe.
—दृढ-व्रत, अस्, आ, अम्, ‘having
firm vows,’ strictly observing religious vows or obli-
gations, firm in religious austerity, having a firm
resolution, persevering, persistent, strict, firm, faithful,
(sometimes used in comp., e. g. भर्तृ-दृढ-
व्रता, q. v.)
—दृढ-शक्तिक, अस्, आ, अम्, of
great power or great strength of will.
—दृढ-
सन्ध, अस्, m. ‘firm or faithful to engagements,’ N.
of one of the 100 sons of Dhṛta-rāṣṭra.
—दृढ-
सन्धि, इस्, इस्, इ, firmly united, closely joined or
allied; strong-knit, thick-set; close, compact, with-
out interstices, well fixed.
—दृढ-सूत्रिका, f.
‘having strong fibres,’ a plant from the fibres of
which bow-strings are made, Sanseviera Zeylanica;
[cf. मूर्वा.]
—दृढ-सेन, अस्, m. ‘possessing a
strong army,’ N. of a prince.
—दृढ-सौहृद,
अस्, ई, अम्, firm in friendship, constant.
—दृढ-
स्कन्ध, अस्, m. ‘strong-stemmed,’ a plant, a sort
of Mimusops (= क्षीरिका).
—दृढ-स्थूण, अस्, आ,
अम्, having firm posts or columns.
—दृढ-हनु,
उस्, m. ‘possessing strong jaws,’ N. of a prince;
[cf. दृढ-धनुस्.]
—दृढ-हस्त, अस्, m.
‘strong-handed,’ N. of one of the 100 sons of
Dhṛta-rāṣṭra.
—दृढाक्ष (˚ढ-अक्˚), अस्, m.
‘strong-eyed,’ N. of a prince.
—दृढाङ्ग (˚ढ-
अङ्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, firm-bodied, hard-limbed, stout,
stalwart; (अम्), n. a diamond.
—दृढानुताप,
अस्, आ, अम्, deeply penitent.
—दृढायु or दृ-
ढायुस् (˚ढ-आय्˚), उस्, m. ‘having a firm life,’
N. of a prince; of a son of Purū-ravas and Urvaśī;
N. of one of the seven sages of the south; of a son
of the third Manu Sāvarṇa.
—दृढायुध (˚ढ-
आय्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, having strong weapons; (अस्), m.
[]
epithet of Śiva; N. of one of the 100 sons of
Dhṛta-rāṣṭra.
—दृढार्ति (˚ढ-अर्˚), इस्, f. the
strong end of a bow; great pain.
—दृढाश्व
(˚ढ-अश्˚), अस्, m. ‘having a strong horse,’ N. of a
son of Dhundhu-māra; of a son of Kāśya.
—दृ-
ढी-करण, अम्, n. or दृढी-कार, अस्, m. making
strong or firm, fixing firmly, corroboration, confir-
mation.
—दृढी-कृ, cl. 8. P. A. -करोति, -कुरुते,
-कर्तुम्, to make firm or fast; to fix, fasten,
make strong, strengthen; to fasten tightly together;
to corroborate, confirm.
—दृढी-भू, cl. 1. P.
-भवति, -भवितुम्, to become strong or fixed.
—दृढेषुधि (˚ढ-इष्˚), इस्, m. ‘having a
strong quiver,’ N. of a prince.
दृढ दृढ. See under rt. दृंह् at p. 427.

दृढय, Nom. P. दृढयति, -यितुम्, to
make firm, to fasten, confirm, strengthen, fortify,
intensify; [cf. द्रढय.]

दृढव्य, अस्, m., N. of a Ṛṣi; (a wrong
form for दृढायु, q. v.)

दृढस्यु, उस्, m., N. of an ancient sage, also
called Idhma-vāha; [cf. दृढ-दस्यु.]

दृढेयु, उस्, m., N. of one of the seven sages
of the west.
